name: hypes
description: Adapt how much help to offer within one explicitly activated task while preserving content and responsibility.

interface.shortDescription: Adapt help within one active task
interface.longDescription: Hypes keeps a recommendation-only control and an explicitly activated task loop. It can propose a different delivery strategy, apply it only after the user chooses it, and use confirmed task-local corrections or bound outcomes on the next turn. It does not write a profile, database, or cross-conversation state.
defaultPrompt: Calculate a separate help recommendation for this task without applying it to the response.
Use Hypes for this task and let me choose whether to apply each different help proposal.
Close this Hypes task session and summarize the four outcome dimensions.
